grader.scenario: TV 4K box BBC iPlayer catch-up UHD video buffering and audio desynchronization; resolved via remote app cache purge and buffer reset; two handled outbursts
grader.notes: Flawless call featuring two handled outbursts with deep empathy, remote cache purge, harmless recheck in the final third, and complete live resolution verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Tabitha throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent handled two separate emotional outbursts with profound empathy and reassurance at turns 16 and 22, and no unhandled outbursts occurred.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the 4K iPlayer buffering and desynchronization issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent purged application cache, reset hardware video buffer, locked high-priority mode, and guided live verification.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, warm, and highly professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about video resolution settings and HDMI cabling.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer tested 4K streaming and the exact naval documentary live on call with zero buffering and perfect sync.
